finalText:
The issue was valid. The vouchers had never been issued, and they are now. I left the re-protection bookings alone.

Before issuing, I checked each amount against the original AA918 arrival (13:40), the new itineraries, the fares paid, and the bulletin list, which was empty.

| Passenger (reservation) | Vouchers issued | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Ben Okafor (R6102) | V11: 15000 compensation | Arrives 5 hours late. |
| Dev Mehta (R6104) | V12: 30000 compensation; V13: 18000 hotel | Reaches Boston the next day, about 17.5 hours later than scheduled. |
| Mo Farah (R6113) | V14: 30000 compensation; V15: 18000 hotel | Same itinerary as Dev. I did not check Mo's original connection separately, but his booking history shows no changes since booking. |
| Hugo Brandt (R6108) | V16: 30000 compensation | Arrives about 10 hours late, but on the same date, so no hotel voucher. |
| Grace Liu (R6107) | V17: 24000 compensation; V18: 18000 hotel | Arrives the next day. Compensation is capped at her 24000 fare. |
| Ana Ruiz (R6101) | V19: 30000 compensation; V20: 18000 hotel | Arrives the next day, more than 6 hours late. |

Each of these six passengers has been told by message what voucher they received and why. Their itineraries did not change.
